actions.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect The chef shouts a flurry of insults and criticisms at either an ally or enemy within 30 feet with the following effects:

Ally The chef's assistant is shaken by the barrage of criticism but is determined to work faster and harder. The target becomes Quickened for 1 round but is also Frightened 1. They can use the extra action to Interact, Step, or Stride, or as part of an action or activity to prepare, cook, or serve food.

Enemy The target must succeed a @Check[will|dc:18] save or take @Damage[1d6[mental]] damage and become frightened 1 (or @Damage[2d6[mental]] damage and Frightened 2 on a critical failure).
actions.name: Angry Rant

actions.description:
Trigger The head chef is targeted with a melee attack by an adjacent attacker they can see

Effect The head chef uses Spice Mix against the attacker.
actions.name: Dash of Spice
actions.trigger: The head chef is targeted with a melee attack by an adjacent attacker they can see

actions.description: The head chef throws a mixture of irritating spices into an adjacent creature's eyes, causing the creature to be Dazzled until it Interacts to clear its vision.
actions.name: Spice Mix

actions.description: For encounters involving cooking and taste, the head chef is a 7th-level challenge.
actions.name: Culinary Specialist

actions.description: The halfling gains a +2 circumstance bonus when using the Seek action to find Hidden or Undetected creatures within 30 feet of them. Whenever the halfling targets a creature that is Concealed or hidden from them, reduce the DC of the flat check to @Check[flat|dc:3] for a concealed target or @Check[flat|dc:9] for a hidden one.
actions.name: Keen Eyes

name: Halfling Head Chef
publicNotes:
Renowned for their culinary expertise, halfling head chefs navigate the complex world of high cuisine with flavorful creations and fiery tempers.

Halflings thrive on simple pleasures—having a pint at the pub or warming their feet by the hearth.
